raw_response_text: {"dividend_assertions":[],"mechanics":[{"surface":"DIVIDEND_FINAL_PERIOD","quote":"In the event that a distribution with respect to the Company Common Shares, Company Preferred Shares or Partnership Units permitted under the terms of this Agreement has a record date prior to the Company Merger Effective Time or OpCo Merger Effective Time, as applicable, and has not been paid prior to the Closing Date, such distribution shall be paid to the holders of such Company Common Shares, Company Preferred Shares or Partnership Units on the Closing Date immediately prior to the Company Merger Effective Time or OpCo Merger Effective Time, as applicable.","detail":"A permitted distribution with a pre-effective-time record date that remains unpaid before Closing is paid immediately before the applicable merger effective time on the Closing Date."}],"open_world_candidates":[]}
